items.title: Gordon Lorraine — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: She taught me about life in the South. She taught me a lot. ... I learned so much from Bessie Smith.

ctx.x: This is while you’re in high school. Correct?

Yeah. Really in high school! I mean, we were wonderfully brilliant young kids who just wanted to hear music—jazz. We gave each other assignments. They’d say, “Ok, tonight when you come, you do the life of Bessie Smith.” I’d sit home, getting all of Bessie’s records out, notating... I said, “Oh, I can’t do that. Whoo...” Whoo, I loved Bessie. She was my favorite at the time. She taught me about life in the South. She taught me a lot. You have to understand. Her lyrics were not just bawdy or off-color. They were…
What other artists did you like at that time?
